reviews.text: Nurse Emely was very kind and Dr. Ngyuenphat was impressive in how well he explained everything and showing how knowledgeable he is in his field, very respectful and very informative.
My husband and I had a great experience at Baxter and Cleo Veterinary Clinic in Spring Branch.  Our Pug puppy is in good hands.  We would highly recommend the clinic.

I called for an emergency appointment and Baxter and Cleo Vet found availability within the hour to bring in my beloved Doberman, Taco. Dr. Nguyen-Phat and Dr. Tran were extremely prompt in seeing Taco to get imaging done and gave sound medical advice for next steps to bring him to the ER after getting imaging done by them.

I can't thank them enough, if you're in the area - you're in good hands with Baxter and Cleo Vet.

A+, highly recommended

I had a wonderful experience at Baxter & Cleo Veterinary Clinic! Dr. Nguyenphat did an amazing job taking care of my cats. He was very knowledgeable, attentive, and took the time to make sure they were comfortable and well cared for.

I really appreciated how thorough he was and how clearly he explained everything to me. It’s always stressful when you’re worried about your pets, but I felt confident knowing they were in good hands.

Thank you, Dr. Nguyenphat and the Baxter & Cleo team, for taking such great care of my cats! I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a caring and trustworthy veterinarian.
I’ve been going here for years. I find the people here very friendly and caring with my older dog. The staff is always very helpful.

Dr. Irell and his team are great, I've been taking my cats to Baxter & Cleo for several years and always treat them kindly, especially my spicy kitty, Jelly. All the procedures and options are explained thoroughly and any questions I have even after the visit are answered.
Absolutely wonderful care and follow up. Best in town!
Nice and professional. Would recommend to anyone needing a vet for their babies
Professional care delivered with patience and courtesy, Dr.made sure I understood all aspects of of Ellie’s care
Exceptional staff with a nice and clean facility! They were all amazing. 10/10 would recommend

Great vet! Dr. Tran (who primarily sees my pups) and the other vets and staff are all very friendly and are great with my dogs. Dr. Tran gets down on the floor with them for shots and they'll often cuddle up onto her lap or plant kisses on her. Usually very easy to get appointments if something comes up or they can try to squeeze your pup in as a drop off if they're really loaded up. Would recommend.
Staff was very friendly. Vet was informative and kind. They were also very transparent with their pricing. This is now our main vet.

I brought my furbaby in because she was sick and had constant diarrhea and vomiting, I called multiple different vets and did not feel confident bringing her there, until I found Baxter and Cleo where the team was amazing and very attentive they were so affordable, very helpful when explaining everything that I needed to know.
This will definitely be my new vet care
Thank you for your 5 star review!
Thank you for your 5 star review!

My cat had a very positive experience when I brought him in for his annual check up and shots. The vet was very thorough and Nurse Harley was super helpful with assisting.  I would highly recommend Baxter and Cleo for your pets needs!

We have 2 dogs and 2 cats that come here, and Baxter & Cleo always do amazing with them.

The lobby is always managed so well, and we are usually brought back to an exam room fairly quickly, which means we don't have to worry about running into other dogs when we take our not-dog-friendly pup (Venus) or our cats in. But you can still tell that they always try to fit pets in ASAP by some magic

They're so gentle and caring with our pets, especially Bowie, who they even saw in the lobby to make it easier on him since he is not a fan of small spaces (he's since graduated to the actual exam room but still needs some extra love during visits).

They let the cats roam free in the exam room in-between being seen by each staff member, which helps a lot with our indoor-only cats who have only been to the vet a few times in their very short lives (both under 2 years).

All-in-all, they're an amazing and dedicated team who put pet needs above all else 💛

Edit: I forgot to mention! Their website has a fantastic and comprehensive Client Education section explaining everything or almost everything you need to know about general pet care :)
Very good communication. Strong caring culture for pet and owner!
This was our first visit and I was very impressed. The staff are friendly and awesome. Thank you for taking such great care of our fur babies ❤️

Dr. Irell was absolutely amazing!! He was friendly, knowledgeable, and patient. It was my first time there and I was so impressed with the entire staff. They explained everything thoroughly, went through costs, and really took care of my cat's issue at a great price. I appreciate everyone. Thank you all!!!
Thank you so much for you 5 star review!
Staff is so caring and sweet. I have to travel with my cat pretty soon and they made excellent recommendations for how to keep her calm and happy !
Thank you for your 5 star review!
They were honestly the brightest lights during my darkest times..
Baxter and Cleo Veterinary Clinic has been taking care of our dogs for so many years.  I love how much they care about our fur babies!!’  10/10 would recommend.
Wonderful care for my very anxious schnauzer. Dr did a very thorough exam and took time addressing my concerns. Nurse Natalie took extra care and was very kind.

I had a very lovely experience, staff are very kind and gentle with pets. The prices are workable, way better than other places I've visited. The place itself is also very clean, neat, and very organized.
Always friendly. Reasonable prices. Never had a bad experience here. They listen and are very patient with my dog.
They treated my baby nano with love.
We are happy to be able to provide affordable pricing to our neighborhood. Thank you for your 5 star review!
Nurse Adriana and Dr.Tran were great with my fearful cat! Enjoyed our experience here

Switched vet clinics because I was wanting something more personable where the staff actually know the pets coming in. From the start, the receptionist knew everyone coming in. Adriana our vet tech was very sweet and my dog adored her. Dr Tran did thorough assessment and I left with no concerns. 10/10 recommend coming here
Don't be late
A very friendly and wonderful vet to go to. They really care about the pets they see. I will continue taking my Pugz there.
They do an amazing job making every animal feel safe and loved. Both my cats and dogs love Baxter and Cleo.

We have been going to Baxter & Cleo for years, my whole family uses this amazing vet! Dr. Tell is great, he takes time with each patient to explain things and always listens! The newest member of our family just went for her first visit Wednesday of this week & crewed each time nurse Valencia walked out of the room (hopefully she will continue that behavior as she gets older)
Excellent caring staff and doctors. Great at preventive and diagnostic care. So proud to have them in our neighborhood!! Thank you for caring for my kitties!!

Highly recommend this place . My pup Royalty has always been well treated here . They are very friendly and attentive to details . Thanks for the great service . I will definitely return here for any of my pet needs .

I love this place.  I brought my cat here twice.  Once for surgery at the last minute for a cat bite.  He had to have surgery.  Dr. Tran was wonderful with him.  Explained in detail what was going on and what had to be done for sore from cat bite.  I had never been here.  They were so very kind made him feel right at home.  Another time my cat hurt his leg and couldn't put weight on the leg for 24hrs.  Dr. Irell was wonderful with my cat.  My cat is very scared but the dr and the vet techs are awesome with scary cats.  He just melted in their hands, let them do anything they needed to do to him.  Price was very reasonable and care was outstanding.  I will be coming back.  Thank you Dr. Tran and Dr. Irell.

DO NOT TAKE YOUR FURRY BABY THERE !!
I have 3 cats that were seen by this clinic and thousands of dollars later all 3 are still sick or worse.
They are nice to you and they don’t make you wait long, but they do not care for the animals. One of my cats got his teeth pulled out due to stomatitis, a serious condition that requires regular visits. Well, the doctor never even said he needed a follow up after his surgery.
Another vet didn’t even touch my 3rd cat, she was afraid to get scratched I guess.
Your pet will not recover from any of their treatment so you’ll continue to spend your money with this clinic.
And if you need to complain about the services, they will blow you off and say they will call you back or send an email instead of taking care of your concerns before you leave a bad review such as this one. SAVE YOUR PET and your money, STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE !!

Unfortunately my dog has to be put down do this people that can't do there proper job i took my sick dog max 10 years old and every time of blood work was done and they informed me that everything was well and gave me some medication, couple days later i took him to a ER vet and they informed me that my dog had cancer and nothing can be done and that has been going on for some time, I spent over 600+ dollars to this clinic just for them to tell me everything was fine, when reality it wasn't,  they will just make you waist you money and in the end they have poor communication skills, never to informed me that the blood work for a senior dog doesn't include testing for cancer, they won't test it if you don't specify to them what to do. Please avoid this place they will never informe you with the correct information, they will continue to charge you anything they want just to get money out on you, save you money and fine a better vet clinic than this one.

The workers here not only care about the fur babies, but about us (owners) too. They’re beyond compassionate, they work with you making sure you & your pets are comfortable. One of my babies was on the verge of dying, they did everything to save him & now he’s living his best life. I recently had my cat pass away (my other baby), I got a letter in the mail from the staff yesterday sending love & condolences. It shows a lot about how they are as people & how much they care. I’m beyond grateful.

Nurse Emely made sure to listen and asked questions so Potato could get his best care. Jade is always a huge help. Potato just loves her which makes it easy to get all his tests done. Dr. Andrew cleared up all my questions and helped me understand when I may need to bring Potato back in. Potato doesn't like going to the vet but the staff helps keep him at ease.
They take such good care of my old man Potato. Jay is always the best at getting him chill enough to get his labs n nails done. My roommate goes here too.

I can’t recommend this vet enough! I was going to another clinic where they couldn’t figure out what was wrong with my puppy, and I was really worried about him getting better. From the moment I came here, the team immediately knew what they were doing and quickly diagnosed the issue.

They created a clear treatment plan, and now my puppy is finally on the road to recovery. I’m so grateful for their knowledge, care, and professionalism!

I just got done at Baxter and Cleo for my two babies Pearl and Hugo but I also take my senior cat Simba there as well. Both of the doctors there are amazing and I have not had any problems with anyone there regarding professionalism and answering all of my questions and being patient with me and how much of a helicopter mom I am. I can't imagine taking my babies anywhere else but here, after having a horrible experience at another vet office here in spring Branch. It's definitely not the cheapest place, but it's also not the most expensive. They work with you and help you make the right decisions on what would be best for your pets. Today I saw Dr. Tran and my nurse/tech was Jessica and both of them were very sweet and caring and you could see and feel their compassion for working with animals and I appreciate that so much in a profession where I've run into a lot of vets that are cold and desensitized. I will forever be taking my cats.

I brought my 14yr old cat to Baxter and Cleo for the  very sad issue of putting her down. She was sick and I was so upset. Nurse Jay stayed with me the whole time and gave me the moral support to fulfill my duty as a cat mom! The clinic was so supportive and understanding of my feelings. I wanted to let everyone know what a compassionate group of people work at Baxter and Cleo. Thank you again for caring!!!
They were great with my Pyr.  Quick, lots of information, helpful, and we felt welcomed.  I am always nervous cause of his size but they did great and highly recommend.

I was an existing client here until I took my dog who was diagnosed with cancer in for her routine bloodwork. The vet actually told me that all the previous doctors and specialists were incorrect and I should disregard her well being to do a 'necessary' tooth cleaning and nail trimming.

I absolutely will not bring my beloved pet back and highly suggest you take caution in placing trust in a clinic that values your wallet more than you pet. Please be CaReful here folks !!!!

Incredible experience. We called and made an appointment for the same day. Reception was very sharp, quick, and detailed. Our animal’s technician, Valencia, was very knowledgable. Her kindness and strong abilities instilled so much confidence in us that our pet was in the right hands. They were completely transparent with pricing, giving us updates on totals for each service as we went along. The pricing also, was beyond fair. Our pet can be a little spicy, but that was no challenge for these professionals. Dr. Irell was also extremely knowledgeable and exuded a real sense of care for our pet. We are beyond impressed by this clinic. Two thumbs up. If I had more thumbs, they would be up too.

Me and my two pups just had our first visit to Baxter & Cleo and I couldn't be happier that we found them. The whole staff was incredibly friendly and the vet techs were amazing!
The vet gave Sam a very thorough exam, which I really appreciated. He even let me know that the flea and tick medication Sam had been on might actually be contributing to his seizures. Which was major news and a very much appreciated bit of info! Our previous vet never mentioned that connection, so it meant a lot to have someone take the time to notice these details and look out for Sam like that.
You can tell everyone here genuinely cares about the people and pets they see. Very highly recommend Baxter & Cleo to anyone looking for a vet who is thorough, honest, and truly invested in your pet's health. So glad we made the switch!
She was calm and very good with the cats
Thank you so much for your 5 star review!
Thank you so much for your 5 star review!

Took the pups in to get their annual check-up and nail trim with Dr. Irell and Nurse Adriana—and as usual, they were Awesome!  Smart, sensitive toward the dogs, and great to interact with—5 Stars plus!  And Adriana is a true animal lover and really puts the dogs at ease—smart, experienced, caring and the absolute best nail trimmer!  Highest recommendation for all!
My 1st time here. Checking In And Making appointment was great.  Jay was Excellent my Blanco was so scared , shy shaken . Never been around anyone just us. She did an Awesome job.
This clinic has the most pleasant and professional staff my and dogs and I have ever worked with.

Great experience overall. The doctors are highly professional and take the time to explain everything clearly and thoroughly. They’re patient, attentive, and always willing to answer questions. They also respond to messages promptly, which I really appreciate.

The staff is friendly and helpful, and the clinic is always clean and well-maintained. Highly recommend.

I had a terminally ill cat that had been treated at Baxter and Cleo.  I called on Monday because the cat’s pain level was too high and requested a vet to call me back  same day and explained the cat had cancer and needed pain relief.  The employee informed me that the vet who treated my car would not be in until the next day and the vet that worked that day would probably not call because they  don’t assist with each others patients.   I wound up having to take him to a different vet to have him euthanized same day because of his pain level.

IMPORTANT NOTE:  I received a call from the practice manager who saw my review.  Baxter and Cleo will improve the way messages, particularly urgent messages, are handled. so that the veterinarians will see them timely and hopefully send responses promptly.
Love having a neighborhood vet! They are so friendly and do a great job listening and giving recommendations. We will be lifelong members!

I’m very grateful to the Baxter and Cleo team for their kindness and professionalism. They were able to see my dog, Mila, the day after I called and quickly diagnosed her. Dr. Irell kept me well informed and took the time to explain everything.
Mila had surgery the following day, and although I was nervous due to her heart murmur, the staff reassured me and made me feel at ease. Her surgery went smoothly, and she’s now recovering well.
Thank you to Dr. Irell, Dr. Tran, and the entire team for their excellent care!
very nice an welcoming! made my Luna feel safe
Thank you for your review! We enjoy having you as part of the Baxter and Cleo family!
Butter Roux had an amazing first visit to Baxter & Cleo. From the front desk to Jade to Dr. Irell everyone has been fantastic!!
Jay is amazing. The whole staff and our Vet is amazing. Our puppies love it here too. Highly recommend!

I have to go monthly with my rescue Chihuahua, Nico,  to get his nails trimmed. He just will not let me do it. The ladies here can not be more kind. It's obvious they love animals and are very gentle with him. Today he was taken care of by "J" Jasmine... she could not have been kinder. I'm so glad when I rescued him this office was right there on the next block in my neighborhood. Makes it very convenient too. Very much recommend for the service these ladies give, and let's face it... without great staff, your business is nothing. Great job every time I go!!

I love Baxter & Cleo. I am a new client from fall of 2025 and they always treat my dog, Biscuit, very well and very fast. My first appointment was actually because Biscuit broke his leg jumping from the couch and they were able to see & treat him that same day!!! I am so grateful to Dr. Tran for making that exception for him. The ladies picking up the phone and sitting at front desk take care of us so well too, they're very informed and kind. I sometimes drop Biscuit off for his procedures and I know they treat him well behind closed doors because he’s always really excited when we get to the vet! Can’t recommend enough.

I been going to Baxter and Cleo for a few years now for both my girls. Jay is my absolute favorite vet and my girls love her too! Shes very patient with them and really shows me she cares about their health.

This place is the best!! Dr. Irell and Harley are the most amazing people!! Harley is so friendly and professional. Dr. Irell is extremely helpful and knowledgeable. He is brilliant. I am so happy I found this place. Because of those two they have a lifelong customer.
Surgery on small dog
Thank you so much for your review! We loved seeing your fur babies and enjoyed them!

I brought my cat to Baxter and Cleo during a stressful time, and they were very kind and helpful. The staff took good care of him and explained everything clearly. Their pricing was also affordable, which I really appreciated. I’m thankful for their care and would recommend them. 🐾
Kobys feeling a lot better !!

Personally, I believe that animal healthcare should be free, but that’s not something they can control if I were going to take my animals to any place to get care this would be the place I would go. They are very caring understanding and will work with your budget. Nurse Harley and Dr. Tran were lifesavers when it came to my dog that had Parvo. He wouldn’t have survived if it weren’t for them. They knew we were low on money and didn’t take advantage of our desperation like many other places would have. They got the price down as low as possible to work with our budget while still giving our dog everything he needed to survive. They are also open on Saturdays, which is a lifesaver if you don’t have the money to go to an animal emergency room.
The staff was so helpful! My fur baby loved his nurse Harley. Will definitely comeback.
Staff was fast, efficient and kind.  Loved the service and they worked my pet into a busy schedule.
Be careful with the deposits, lost $100 trying to just schedule an appointment for my sick cats. Manager here is heartless and not understanding at all with mix ups. 0/5

I only visited the clinic once, and they were so kind and attentive to my pet and me. Everyone is so lovely; the assistant, Jazmín, is an angel! I hope to continue taking her there because they communicate clearly and are always willing to help your pet!

Update: 2 years ago and I am still traumatized by the images of my lifeless cat with glazed eyes after having a urine sample taken.  I cant unsee this and i am still grieving her death.

Dr. Irell effectively killed my cat while taking a urine sample.  I could hear her screaming in the treatment area.  Minutes later I was brought back to my lifeless, glass eyed cat.  He said she was in respiratory distress.  I ended up having to euthanize her and when the vet tech couldnt hit the vein, Dr. Irell just stood there listing to the stethoscope instead of stepping up to put my baby out of pain.  He never even apologized.   In Veterinary medicine, you are not supposed to continue when an animal is fearful.  Dr. Irell continued to attempt a urine draw when he already told me he didnt feel much in her bladder AND after she peed herself on the table.  So many things went wrong.  Techs should have stepped up and said something to stop the procedure.  My sweet baby died a horrific death for absolutely no reason.  This all could have been prevented.  I am left with a giant hole in my heart. When I think of my sweet cat, I cant think of good memories but just the horrific way her life ended.  I am so devastated.

Edit (Response to Vet).  Yes my cat was senior but I hate when vets shame you because you don't bring your animals in each year.  Most of us don't even go to the Doctor every year ourselves.  And as an indoor cat she was healthy and being fed a premium pet food.  She was not overweight or underweight.  She came to the vet because she had peed on the bed ONCE and that not normal.  I always bring my pets to the vet when there is a problem.   All of the courtesy things done after my cat passed could have been totally avoided had my cat been treated appropriately during the exam.
Very attentive and reasonably priced. They know who you are and take good care of your pet.

First time patients as of tonight and we can confidently say we found the perfect fit! Nurse Jay was GREAT with our little potato of a beagle!! She sang to her and made sure she felt comfortable the entire time. The front desk staff was kind and very attentive. Very clean and no odor. Thank you team!!

Hello if you are looking for an affordable vet (VERY affordable!!) and compassionate care, look no further than this vet clinic. The facilities, rooms, and lobby are always so clean. The techs are so friendly and welcoming. Their veterinarians are very thorough, professional, and take the time to explain things and answer all questions.

I take my cats here and they get star treatment each time. They are especially gentle and patient with some of my scaredy cats. I never thought for a moment that my cats weren’t in great hands. The techs also give a detailed estimate before they perform any treatments, so you know what you’re getting into. I recommend this vet and I don’t go anywhere else. Wish I could give more stars.

About a week ago, I noticed my Siamese having labored breathing. Considering Baxter & Cleo had been the regular vet for my Husky and Siamese after moving from Seabrook 3-4 years ago, I reached out to schedule an appointment. My Siamese was 16. I was under no illusions that he may be very sick or not coming home with me after that appointment. I explained what I’d noticed, and Ms. Gloria, who was very kind over the phone, urged me to take him to an ER vet clinic, like Gulf Coast Veterinary Specialists, which is closest. I took him there last time he had a health related issue (Baxter & Cleo said they couldn’t help with). $3000+ later, GCVS concluded that Simon had lost his vision, which, come to find, would have taken very little for Baxter & Cleo to diagnose, as a veterinary ophthalmologist was not necessary.

Explaining to Ms. Gloria that I could not afford that expense, I expressed my desperation in scheduling an appointment. While timing was not ideal, taking Simon to Baxter and Cleo was, unfortunately, my most affordable option. It made me feel sick that I couldn’t spend more to have him looked at asap, regardless of cost. I did not demand that he be seen right then, that day, or even the day after. He just needed to be seen and I was asking for the next available appointment. Simply put, I was looking for help (and compassion) during, what would become one of the hardest decisions I’ve had to make. After some push back, eventually, I was connected with a veterinarian. As soon as he came on the line, he did not introduce himself, greet me, or ask me what was going on. In a very curt manner, with little patience or compassion, he was emphatic about how I could not be seen today,  there was nothing he could do, I couldn’t have someone’s spot, and that I needed to take Simon to an ER vet clinic instead. After (again) explaining my budgetary limitations, begging for an appointment, explaining that I know my baby may be at the end of his life, and that I was just trying to do my best and right by Simon, I asked why I couldn’t at least schedule an appointment? Why was he being so adamant about not being able to help me? I just began to cry and begged him to help me, to schedule an appointment as soon as I could or even be put on a waitlist, should someone cancel.

Something was really wrong with Simon and I was looking for some care, grace, and/or compassion from a place I had been taking my Husky and Siamese to for at least 3 years. He was not listening, or he was and just didn’t care. We all have bad days and that could have been the case, however, I was not asking for special treatment, to be seen right then, or asking to take anyone’s appointment from them, like he accused me of doing. Eventually, and with an exasperated tone, the veterinarian agreed to schedule an appointment Monday, reiterating that I could not be seen today, tomorrow, or have anyone else’s appointment (which I never ever ever asked for, just the soonest available).

Trying to compose myself, I was grateful, had a little relief, but still in tears. Ms. Gloria came back on the line and kindly set me up with an appointment for Monday afternoon. She confirmed that I was also on the waiting list, that she would call if something opened up sooner. It was not what I wanted for Simon, but I was slightly relieved that he could be seen by his veterinarians, where he was familiar, less stressed. Shortly after ending the call with Ms. Gloria, she called back and offered an appointment for first thing Monday at 8:30 AM. I was additionally grateful but still in shock over what it took to get there.

Simon’s health deteriorated rapidly within 24 hours. At about 4 AM the next day, luckily, I found a more affordable 24 hour veterinary clinic option, BluePearl. They were so kind and patient. Granted it was more expensive than Baxter and Cleo, but not near as much as GCVS. The money component is so trivial considering the nature of the situation, but they offered compassion from the initial phone call to the moment I left their office. For that I’m grateful.

Our Goldendoodle has been coming here since we’ve had him at 8 weeks old. He’s nearly 4 years old now and loves visiting the vet. The vet and techs are so knowledgeable and friendly, and they always provide the best services. We love it here.
The most kind and gentle staff!
Fantastic service under pressure and otherwise! Kind and compassionate!

For 10 years my small town had a horrible vet where my dog Charlie had traumatic experiences. 2 years ago we moved and started going to my family's vet, Baxter & Cleo. It has been an amazing experience for both of us. They are wonderful with her.
The staff and vets are great and extremely knowledgeable! They take the time to answer all your questions!

With all number of vets around in the area, finding one who works well with our dog could be a challenge.  We are grateful that we didn't have to spend too much time looking and are thankful that Baxter and Cleo worked out well for us and our furbaby.  They are attentive both front desk and vet.
Everyone at Baxter and Cleo is so nice, kind, and gentle with our pet!
Thank you for the review, Mom! Please let us know how we can make this a 5-star review.

My husband and I love Baxter and Cleo! The staff is amazing and they are what makes the place great. Maddy is the best receptionist and care taker to our 3 fur baby Boxer's and our new kitten. Maddy is very responsive, professional and friendly. If you're looking for a community that loves animals then I recommend bringing your pets here!

Baxter and Cleo has been the best vet office I’ve ever visited.
From the receptionist to the doctor, every team member genuinely cares about your pup’s well-being. Their compassion and professionalism make all the difference.

Thank you, Baxter and Cleo, for being a welcoming and loving home for my fur baby. We’re so grateful for the care you provide!

I am new to this side of town and my dog wasn’t feeling well. They scheduled us in right away. Vet and staff are super friendly! I had to do a follow up and again worked my dog in same day! Prices are very reasonable. I am so glad I was referred here 🐶😊 …
Everyone in this office is wonderful. They care so much about the animals, and they communicate clearly with you about treatment options. I can’t recommend them highly enough.

Amazing veterinary clinic, receptionist was very nice and attentive. Service here is always great, been taking my sweet Coco here for about two years now and I feel she always gets the proper care she needs especially with her skin issues.
They are so caring and always find a way to make time for us in emergencies. Amazing people and practice

Came to this location on a recommendation from my daughter’s boyfriend. In all my years trying to find a great vet place to take my dogs, well I found it. Outstanding service, extremely knowledgeable and helpful. My Cooper has received the best care. Thank you so much for everything! Highly recommend!
I love this vet! They always take good care of my cat. Super empathetic vets & staff. I will always take my babies here. Definitely recommend!
Fantastic vet! Great staff

Finally!! I have found our forever vet! Everyone at Baxter & Cleo were very nice, took the time to speak through my concerns and were able to get two of my dogs in the same/next day! A very special shout out to Jay, a true “dog whisperer” for her kind and gentle soul. My dogs liked her, which says EVERYTHING!
Staff is lovely and helpful. Everyone works great together. Pets get in and out with great costumer service and a smile.
10/10 i always take my baby hazel here. no wait time . clear understanding of my payment plan . i’m a first time cat owner and Maddy has made it easy with appointments and scheduling.

I'm relatively new customer. My kittens Kaipo & Koa love it there!! They got a pawdicure as well & a tasty treat. They tell me Jay is the go to girl for nails. I finally found another vet after my other retired. Trust them for ALL my babies. Vets are AMAZING!! Another Spring Branch treasure. Thank you Baxter & Cleo.

Harley was super helpful. Explained everything thoroughly and made the process super relaxing and comfortable for me and our pets. Receptionist and staff were just as great. Thank you so much ! Would definitely come back

super awesome and considerate staff!
The vets, nurses, and receptionist were really nice and thorough with their exam and explanations. were the sweetest ever considering i have a screaming dog that doesn’t ever stop, they were still so happy to help! felt so welcomed!
Highly recommend, everyone is really nice and helpful , thank you. A special  thank you to Jasmine for being so caring with Roko .

Very helpful and considerate. I had brought a problem from an emergency vet (basically had to go to kitty ER while Baxter wasn't open) and they could've absolutely charged me for redundant tests, they didn't. Not to mention everyone seems genuinely polite and nice and very interested in their work. I also like that they send reminders for things like vaccines and check ups.

I loved this pet clinic. There was no waiting when I went. Although my baby was behind on his vaccines they took really good care of him. Now, he is back on track and is now up to date with everything. He was a little nervous at first but as you can see at the end of the visit he was very satisfied with his care.
Excellent care for our furry friends

I came in on the 26th of June 2025 at 2:30 for my 2:50 appt and was able to be seen immediately which was nice. I know sometimes appointments run a bit long which is no fault of anyone but it was great to hit the ground running so to speak. Totally the place to go for great staff, a welcoming and clean environment, and more than reasonable prices. A plus too is that the outside has a few grassy areas for the dogs to do their business before going inside lol. The new client intake was easy and on an ipad.

The person who greeted me was attentive and warm and even gave me a penny towards my total that ended up at $233.71 which I thought was incredibly sweet. She also helped me pick up my almost 70 lbs dog onto the scale which is another one of the little things that made my experience great.

The office visit/consultation was $50, a year bordetella shot was $30, dermatology test was about $50, heartworm test was about $30 (super quick too), the trio simperica was about $40, the ear cleaner for my pup’s yeast infection was $40, and the treatment itself was about $40.  (I rounded up some prices just for convenience sake). I was able to pay part in cash and part in card which I’m not sure if it’s standard in vet places but it’s appreciated as I know some places take card only.

The tech (assistant?) was also helpful in telling me the estimated cost of everything before we moved forward and I felt comfortable enough to ask about the price of the bordetella vaccine (which was oral and I didn’t know that was a thing so that was kewl) cost like 3 times lol. She was also kind enough to get on the floor with my dog and demonstrate with her body language that she obviously meant no harm to him. I was not used to her patience due to previous experiences at other vet clinics. She really took the time to make him feel comfortable by holding his paws, not rushing into checking his ears and using a gentle hand. I feel like she really put herself into my dog’s paws and praised him after we did anything to make him feel more comfortable. My dog was even given a treat for his bravery.  I felt like I was manhandling my dog more than they were lol (which wasn’t done at any degree by them).

The veterinarian even gave my fur kid a complementary dewclaw nail trim for the back paws and used a clotting power for the one nail that was cut a bit too short (it happens nbd I’m glad there was a powder they could use to prevent further bleeding).

All in all, I was more than happy with my service and I plan to tell more people about this establishment and the wonderful people who work there and hopefully stay for quite a while. My mother will also be taking the family dog here despite having a vet clinic down the street; the 20 minute drive from uptown is totally worth it. After seeing 4 other places and their practices, I 1000% recommend going here. I can’t thank y’all enough and I hope this review helps whoever is looking for top notch care for their animals. I’ll even bet yall a dollar it’ll be a good experience which is my next get rich quick scheme lolz. Thanks again!
